messages:
morgan: FYI - SCIM provisioning to Okta failing for tenant tenant-123 after the KMS alias rotate at 03:08 UTC. Getting 403 from provisioner and KMS decrypt errors in the logs.

morgan: log snippet:
```
ERROR provisioner/provision.go:142 decrypt error: kms.Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: Authentication tag mismatch
correlation_id=abcd-1234 tenant=tenant-123
```

raj: which cloud KMS is this using? did the alias change or was the key rekeyed?

morgan: AWS KMS, alias `alias/redwood-provisioner` was rotated to `alias/redwood-provisioner-v2`. We did a key rotation earlier today. Not sure if the service account was rewrapped.

elaine: two quick checks: 1) confirm the IAM principal for the SCIM provisioner still has kms:Decrypt on the new key. 2) check whether the provisioner is configured to accept rotated aliases (we have a short window fallback).

morgan: running local decrypt test now: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://token.enc --key-id alias/redwood-provisioner-v2 --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode`

sre-oncall: I see provisioner returned a 403 because decrypt returned InvalidCiphertextException -> typically means the ciphertext was created under a different key material or the principal can't decrypt. Could be extid rewrap mismatch. Did someone remove an IAM role?

raj: I remember a cleanup PR yesterday that removed some unused roles. Can someone check PR #5123? It may have pruned `provisioner-decrypt` role binding for the infra service account.

morgan: yep, #5123 removed a cluster role-binding with label `cleanup=true`. It targeted `svc-account:scim-provisioner@infra`. That would explain the ACL drop. @deploy-bot did a deploy at 03:10 UTC around the same time.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra/provisioner v1.14.3 (commit a1b2c3) - 2026-03-23T03:12:04Z

elaine: mitigation options: A) re-add the IAM role to let the provisioner decrypt current ciphertexts, or B) rewrap the SCIM tokens with the new key and push them into the tenant record. A is fastest. Also run the audit query for kms:Decrypt denies to correlate.

raj: if >200 users are impacted we should escalate to Sev2. Also collect CloudTrail / Audit log entries for `Decrypt` + `scim:Provision` around 03:08-03:15 UTC. That will help CS outreach and backfill scope.

morgan: re-applied role-binding (k8s rbac + IAM) and restarted provisioner pod. Decrypt test now returns plaintext, provisioning requests are 200. Starting backfill for failed enrolls.

morgan: backfill command: `./scripts/scim_replay --tenant tenant-123 --since 2026-03-23T03:00Z`

elaine: link to runbook for this class of issue: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-decrypt-failure-scim - follow post-incident checklist and capture keys/aliases involved.

sre-oncall: created alert `scim-provisioner-decrypt-errors` -> paging suppressed while mitigation in progress. Please update when backfill completes.

morgan: backfill started, initial batch succeeded. Will post final numbers when finished :thumbsup:
